title: Crimson Mist - Action combat demo - Spells and guns - Feedback welcome
author: DulaLipa
selftext:
DISCLAIMER: NONE OF THIS IS FINAL, THIS IS PURELY EARLY AN TESTING VIDEO DEMO.

Here I want to show everyone how this project I've been working on has evolved a bit, it now has some very barebones AI that feels somewhat competitive.

Here I wanted to showcase a boss type enemy that most likely won't be in the final game, called the Hexer, along with some shamblers walking around to add a third partying threat to both the player and the boss.

(The music is not from the game, it is reference material only)

Feedback welcome

comments.author: Purple_Ad_2686
comments.body: Looks great! Did you generate all these assets yourself using AI, or did you source them from somewhere?

replies.author: DulaLipa
replies.body:
Hey thank you!

They are generated with AI. The concept art is made by grok/cursor and the 3d models by meshy.

replies.author: Purple_Ad_2686
replies.body: Thanks for sharing! How did you handle the 3D animations for the models? Did you use Mixamo or another AI auto-rigging tool?

replies.author: DulaLipa
replies.body: Mixamo all the way, though for more complex actions it's starting to bottleneck big time, I might  move on to some AI animation generating service soon.

replies.author: Purple_Ad_2686
replies.body: Curious to know which AI animation services you're looking into! Are you considering video-to-motion tools like Plask/DeepMotion, or something else?
